latHint: Think a giant from Greek myth - not a book of maps.
pivHint: An ATLAS is a book of maps - but in Greek myth ATLAS is which giant, holding up the sky?
winText: Shouldering it. ATLAS was the pivot - a book of maps to a TITAN.
lossText: TITAN - a giant of Greek myth. ATLAS was the pivot: a map ATLAS to ATLAS the giant.
